evidence.frontend: React, Next.js and TypeScript interfaces — A&A-EUcoins, MY TIME, NAJMO, DevHub.
evidence.backend: Services in Next.js, Go, Node.js, Python/Flask and FastAPI.
evidence.database: PostgreSQL and Redis (A&A-EUcoins); SQLite (Accounting Pro, CryptoGemScanner, Supply Lens).
evidence.mobile: Expo / React Native, Capacitor, an Android APK that sends over 2 SIMs, an Android ROM design.

evidence.product: Specification v1.0 and a clickable prototype (CactusOS); written descriptions and stack notes for every project.
evidence.ai: A local AI coding agent on llama.cpp (VESNA); AI-assisted development and debugging in all of them.
